lifecycle_contract.output_bound: 8 + 4*N + 64 native bytes plus descriptor and 12-byte prefix
lifecycle_contract.decode: validate exact native grammar and decoded size before vendor call; scratch buffers guard vendor overread/overwrite
lifecycle_contract.return_length: actual frame bytes, including eight-byte native header
lifecycle_contract.finalize: required, emits zero bytes; repeated call rejected
lifecycle_contract.reset: new context per independent repetition; C ABI reset preserves timer setting

stream_components.descriptor: 12-byte prefix plus canonical JSON containing variant, dtype, shape and logical length
stream_components.payload: Delta or XFF low-dimensional Sprintz RLE stream
stream_components.accounting: FinalBits = 8 * entire serialized stream; no external side information

upstream_tests.evidence: runs/sprintz-u8-formal-12000-20260919: 20 PASS eligible repetitions, two summaries, two PASS coverage tasks; synthetic fixture only

known_limitations: Only unsigned 8-bit integer, one channel, no validity, no timestamps; 16-bit, signed, float, and MTS are not qualified.
Requires AVX2, BMI2 and LZCNT; no scalar fallback, runtime ISA dispatch or streaming.
The registered dataset is synthetic and must not be presented as a real-world ranking corpus.
The first formal run-set hit the 2000-iteration ceiling in all 20 repetitions; it remains as failed raw evidence.
The benchmark's timing loop is not reused; native API timing is auxiliary to the formal PIPELINE scope.
